rows.stdout:
✔ independent verifier accepts actual cloud signer wire values and exports only bounded hashes (1.157708ms)
✔ foreign/stale/expired/revoked/date-only/extra fields and signature drift fail before VERIFIED (0.337041ms)
✔ invalid owned input never fetches a secret; wrong secret binding is rejected (0.158291ms)
✔ firmware fixture is non-executable and requires the bound KMS key, RSA signature and exact bytes (50.960042ms)
✔ controlled worker binds frozen sources, dedicated test role and current input before key access (2.123917ms)
✔ historical SuperAdmin/empty-daily reliability evidence cannot close the new Operator and exact-production criteria (1.997208ms)
✔ daily wait consumes actual bounded API envelope and times out without shared invocations (1.46ms)
✔ unknown Operator preparation freezes cleanup; no fake login or destructive recovery (0.187167ms)
✔ known Operator cleanup checks exact disabled tombstone and stops unknown disable without retry (0.679166ms)
✔ natural daily frame must belong to the selected Replay device; foreign and borrowed frames fail closed (0.129833ms)
✔ range reads keep the original default and permit bounded slow-link retry (0.405042ms)
✔ range reads reject unbounded, ambiguous and below-default timeouts (0.19975ms)
✔ read-only asset concurrency stays bounded independently of DB/API capacity (0.110667ms)
✔ whole-asset reads remain within the existing 32 MiB artifact bound and retain the default (0.075375ms)
✔ S3 full-object verification rejects multipart/composite, wrong version/size/hash and absent SHA256 (0.132459ms)
✔ nonempty Replay requires exact scope, terminal success, real scan and zero failures (0.506791ms)
✔ consumer proof binds root and final to all identities and one invocation (0.134042ms)
✔ single submission persists uncertainty first, never retries denial, timeout or missing ID (0.974333ms)
✔ small consumer pages project metadata and stop on repeated tokens, failures and total budget (0.587833ms)
✔ dedup gate refuses empty frames, missing tables and changed receipt/aggregate/archive data (0.215375ms)
✔ real readonly SQL verifies owned device/customer scope and leaves outside and owned rows intact (633.829ms)
✔ Replay observation discovers only exact owned duplicate IDs without claiming Job-to-SQS producer mapping (0.450375ms)
✔ consumer reader fails closed on oversized pages and page cap without mutation recovery (0.14525ms)
✔ fresh own MQTT session closes predecessor, disables reconnect and cannot touch a foreign device (0.401958ms)
✔ PUBACK has a bounded functional deadline, owns late rejection and never resubmits unknown publication (83.500042ms)
✔ cleanup never starts under unknown/running write ownership or retries an unknown cleanup Build (0.170708ms)
✔ only bounded fields are projected and an exact unique Job/source/SQS tuple proves production (0.785709ms)
✔ collector reads the exact fixed log group; truncation and repeated tokens cannot pass (0.347875ms)
✔ terminal Replay alone never releases cleanup; exact root and final consumer outcomes are required (0.178833ms)
✔ only exact fresh suppressed identities and matching customer scopes are allowed (0.614709ms)
✔ real SQL seeds only INVITED and preserves outside users; duplicate seed never replays (634.099041ms)
✔ foreign customer and outside-user trigger mutation roll back all seed writes (417.753209ms)
✔ identity provisioning suppresses delivery, requires real returned subject, and cannot act on foreign names (0.857875ms)
✔ response rejection is owned even when the browser action fails first (0.563542ms)
✔ unknown fixture start is preserved and surfaced as a stop condition without replay (1.214ms)
✔ cleanup recovery rejects foreign identities and sites before any AWS operation (265.345541ms)
